4	  "questions": [
5	    {"id": "Q-001", "question": "When a line manager is away, how do we know, and can the manager and their own manager both decide the same request?",
6	     "why_it_matters": "You decided that a manager's own manager can step in when the manager is away. Without a clear rule, requests could be stuck with nobody able to decide, or two managers could decide the same request differently.",
7	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-008", "FEA-001", "FEA-014", "REQ-002"], "topic_keywords": ["manager", "away", "stand-in", "approver"],
8	     "options": [
9	       {"option": "The manager marks themselves away, and only then can their manager decide", "trade_offs": "Clear and auditable, but requests wait if the manager forgets to mark themselves away."},
10	       {"option": "The manager's own manager can decide at any time, alongside the manager", "trade_offs": "Requests never get stuck, but two people may both act, so the first decision must win and the second person is told."},
11	       {"option": "The manager's own manager can decide only after a request has waited a set number of days", "trade_offs": "No manual step, but needs an agreed waiting time and delays urgent requests."}
12	     ],
13	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": true, "priority": "critical"},
14	    {"id": "Q-002", "question": "What should a manager see and do when reviewing a loan request, and how do they find requests waiting for them?",
15	     "why_it_matters": "Approving and declining is the step that turns a request into a loan, but the mockup shows no manager screen at all, so this part of the feature cannot be specified yet.",
16	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-001", "REQ-002"], "topic_keywords": ["manager", "approve", "decline", "queue"],
17	     "options": [
18	       {"option": "A list of requests waiting for the manager, with approve and decline on each request", "trade_offs": "Simple and quick for managers; needs a new manager screen."},
19	       {"option": "Managers act only from the email they receive", "trade_offs": "Least new screen design, but harder to see everything waiting and relies on email delivery."},
20	       {"option": "Both a waiting list and links from the email", "trade_offs": "Most convenient, with more to design and build."}
21	     ],
22	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": true, "priority": "critical"},
23	    {"id": "Q-003", "question": "Who may see a staff member's loan requests and decline reasons, and can someone request equipment for another person?",
24	     "why_it_matters": "Loan records and decline reasons are about individual people, so showing them to the wrong person could expose personal information.",
25	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-014", "FEA-004", "REQ-003", "REQ-001"], "topic_keywords": ["visibility", "privacy", "own", "behalf"],
26	     "options": [
27	       {"option": "Staff see only their own requests; managers also see their direct reports' requests", "trade_offs": "Matches the approval rule and keeps data limited; stand-in managers need access to the reports they cover."},
28	       {"option": "Staff see only their own requests; managers see only requests waiting for their decision", "trade_offs": "Smallest exposure of personal data, but managers cannot look back at past decisions."},
29	       {"option": "Anyone in the company can see all loans", "trade_offs": "Easy to see what equipment is out, but exposes individuals' decline reasons unless they are hidden."}
30	     ],
31	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": true, "priority": "critical"},
32	    {"id": "Q-004", "question": "Who can cancel a request and until when, who records that an item has been returned, and what happens if an item is not returned by its end date?",
33	     "why_it_matters": "Each status (pending, approved, declined, cancelled, returned) needs a person or event that sets it. Otherwise statuses appear that nobody can set, and cancelled or returned items may never become free for others.",
34	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-005", "FEA-009", "REQ-003", "REQ-002"], "topic_keywords": ["cancel", "return", "status", "overdue"],
35	     "options": [
36	       {"option": "Staff can cancel until approved; a manager records the return", "trade_offs": "Clear roles, with managers doing extra work and cancelling after approval needing a manager."},
37	       {"option": "Staff can cancel any time before the loan starts; a designated equipment owner records the return", "trade_offs": "Flexible for staff, but needs someone named as equipment owner."},
38	       {"option": "Either staff or their manager can cancel; the manager records the return and overdue items are flagged to the manager", "trade_offs": "Covers overdue items, but adds a flag or email that needs designing."}
39	     ],
40	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": true, "priority": "critical"},
41	    {"id": "Q-005", "question": "Where does the information about each person's line manager, and that manager's manager, come from?",
42	     "why_it_matters": "Who may approve a request and who is emailed on submission both depend on this, and nothing supplied says where it is held or how changes are reflected.",
43	     "affected_ids": ["FEA-013", "REQ-002", "ASM-F-001"], "topic_keywords": ["reporting", "line", "manager", "directory"],
44	     "options": [
45	       {"option": "Use an existing company system such as an HR system or staff directory", "trade_offs": "Always up to date, but needs access to that system and its owner's agreement."},
46	       {"option": "Keep the reporting lines inside this feature, maintained by an administrator", "trade_offs": "Self-contained, but someone must keep it current as people move."},
47	       {"option": "Upload a staff and manager list periodically", "trade_offs": "Simple to build, but can be out of date between uploads."}
48	     ],
49	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": true, "priority": "important"},
50	    {"id": "Q-006", "question": "Do staff request a specific item (for example Laptop L-221) or any item of a type, can one request cover several items, and who maintains the list of items?",
51	     "why_it_matters": "The rule that an item cannot be loaned twice for overlapping dates cannot be built until we know what is being booked and who keeps the list correct.",
52	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-009", "FEA-010", "REQ-001", "ASM-G-001"], "topic_keywords": ["item", "catalogue", "asset", "equipment"],
53	     "options": [
54	       {"option": "Specific individual items, one per request, maintained by an administrator", "trade_offs": "Precise tracking of who has what; staff must pick a particular item and an administrator keeps the list."},
55	       {"option": "Item types (for example Laptop), with the system assigning a free item", "trade_offs": "Easier for staff, but needs a way to assign and track the individual item."},
56	       {"option": "Item types or items, with several items allowed in one request", "trade_offs": "Convenient for bundles, but approval and availability become more complex."}
57	     ],
58	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": true, "priority": "important"},
59	    {"id": "Q-007", "question": "Must a manager give a reason when declining a request, and where do they enter it?",
60	     "why_it_matters": "You said staff see any decline reason. This decides whether declined staff always get an explanation.",
61	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-007", "FEA-012", "REQ-002", "REQ-003", "ASM-G-002"], "topic_keywords": ["decline", "reason", "required"],
62	     "options": [
63	       {"option": "A reason is required", "trade_offs": "Staff always get an explanation, but declining takes slightly longer."},
64	       {"option": "A reason is optional", "trade_offs": "Quicker for managers, but some declined staff see no explanation."}
65	     ],
66	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": false, "priority": "important"},
67	    {"id": "Q-008", "question": "The mockup shows the status 'Requested', but your status list says 'pending'. Which wording should staff see for a request awaiting a decision?",
68	     "why_it_matters": "Staff read this label to know where their request stands, and it should match across the list, emails and specification.",
69	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-006", "FEA-008", "REQ-003", "ASM-G-003"], "topic_keywords": ["requested", "pending", "label", "status"],
70	     "options": [
71	       {"option": "Use 'Pending' and update the mockup", "trade_offs": "Matches your decided statuses; the design changes."},
72	       {"option": "Use 'Requested' as the displayed label for the pending state", "trade_offs": "Keeps the mockup as is, but the label differs from the decided status name."},
73	       {"option": "They are two different states", "trade_offs": "Adds a sixth status that needs its own meaning and rules."}
74	     ],
75	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": false, "priority": "important"},
76	    {"id": "Q-009", "question": "After staff submit a request successfully, what should they see?",
77	     "why_it_matters": "The mockup's Submit request button leads nowhere, and staff need to know their request was sent and where to find it.",
78	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-002", "FEA-011", "REQ-001", "REQ-003"], "topic_keywords": ["submit", "confirmation", "success"],
79	     "options": [
80	       {"option": "A confirmation page that says the request was sent", "trade_offs": "Unmistakable, but one more screen and one more click to get back."},
81	       {"option": "Return to the loans list with a message and the new request shown as pending", "trade_offs": "Faster, and shows the request in place; the message must be easy to notice."}
82	     ],
83	     "recommendation": null, "blocking": false, "priority": "important"},
84	    {"id": "Q-010", "question": "If a request cannot be submitted, what should staff see, and should the details they entered be kept?",
85	     "why_it_matters": "Staff should not have to retype the item and dates if something goes wrong, and should understand what to fix.",
86	     "affected_ids": ["GAP-002", "FEA-007", "FEA-011", "F-GAP-002-01", "REQ-001"], "topic_keywords": ["error", "validation", "failure", "entries"],
87	     "options": [
88	       {"option": "Keep entered values and show each message next to the field it concerns", "trade_offs": "Easiest to fix; non-validation failures such as a server error still need their own general message."},
89	       {"option": "Clear the form and show one general message", "trade_offs": "Simplest to build, but staff must re-enter everything."}
90	     ],
91	     "recommendation": {"option": "Keep entered values and show each message next to the field it concerns", "finding_ids": ["F-GAP-002-01"], "rationale": "The kept finding says to keep entered data and show messages beside their fields when validation fails. It is low confidence and covers validation failure only."},
92	     "blocking": false, "priority": "important"}
93	  ],
94	  "implementation_details": [
95	    {"item": "Where staff and manager email addresses come from, for the agreed email notifications", "related_ids": ["ASM-F-002", "FEA-006"]},
96	    {"item": "Enforcing at decision time that only the eligible approver can approve or decline, and that a second decision on a decided request is not applied", "related_ids": ["FEA-002", "FEA-014"]},
97	    {"item": "How users sign in and are identified", "related_ids": ["ASM-F-001"]}
98	  ]

13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	This feature lets staff request to borrow equipment, lets line managers approve or decline those requests, and lets staff see where their requests stand. The customer's three requirements are short, so most of the behaviour is not yet defined.
16	
17	What is decided: an item cannot be loaned to two people for overlapping dates and the form only offers free dates (DEC-001). Only a requester's own line manager can decide a request, and that manager's own manager can step in when the manager is away (DEC-003). Staff are emailed when a request is approved or declined, and managers are emailed when a request is submitted (DEC-004). Requests are pending, approved, declined, cancelled or returned, and staff see the status, the dates and any decline reason (DEC-005).

19	Key open decisions that block the specification: how a manager is known to be away, what the manager screen looks like, who can see a person's loans, who can cancel and who records a return, where reporting-line data comes from, and whether staff request specific assets or item types. # Equipment Loan Requests: Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261012-154937-f3f269
- Date: 2026-10-12
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: pending final pass
- Known limitations: Capture status is complete (2 pages, no capture limitations recorded), but it was taken from a fixture, so only two screens exist and no manager screen, empty, loading or error state was captured. Research ran in fixture mode with recorded results only (robots.txt not checked). Research was limited to the first two research gaps by DEC-006. One finding was kept (F-GAP-002-01), with low confidence, and its source says it is a test fixture and not real documentation. The research for GAP-001 found no usable source.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004, Q-005 and Q-006 are blocking and unanswered (see section 16). REQ-001 and REQ-003 carry the label Conflicting and GAP-006 is Conflicting (see sections 6 and 7).

## 2. Executive Summary

This feature lets staff request to borrow equipment, lets line managers approve or decline those requests, and lets staff see where their requests stand. The customer's three requirements are short, so most of the behaviour is not yet defined.

What is decided: an item cannot be loaned to two people for overlapping dates and the form only offers free dates (DEC-001). Only a requester's own line manager can decide a request, and that manager's own manager can step in when the manager is away (DEC-003). Staff are emailed when a request is approved or declined, and managers are emailed when a request is submitted (DEC-004). Requests are pending, approved, declined, cancelled or returned, and staff see the status, the dates and any decline reason (DEC-005).

Key open decisions that block the specification: how a manager is known to be away, what the manager screen looks like, who can see a person's loans, who can cancel and who records a return, where reporting-line data comes from, and whether staff request specific assets or item types. The mockup also shows the status "Requested", which is not in the decided status list, and its date inputs do not show the free-dates-only rule. Ten gaps were deferred at checkpoint 2 and are listed under Deferred.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Staff can request an equipment loan by choosing an item and loan dates (REQ-001).
- Line managers can approve or decline loan requests (REQ-002).
- Staff can see the status of their own loan requests (REQ-003).
- No item is ever loaned to two people for overlapping dates (DEC-001).

### In Scope

- The staff request form and the staff loans list, as captured in the mockup (SCR-001, SCR-002).
- Manager approval and decline of requests from direct reports, including the stand-in rule (DEC-003). No manager screen was captured, so its design is open (GAP-001, Q-002).
- Email notifications on submission and on approval or decline (DEC-004).
- The status set pending, approved, declined, cancelled and returned (DEC-005).
- Approved gaps awaiting customer decisions: GAP-001, GAP-002, GAP-005, GAP-006, GAP-007, GAP-008, GAP-009 and GAP-014.

### Out of Scope / Rejected

Nothing is recorded as rejected or excluded. The run's decisions contain no rejection, and no customer requirement excludes anything. Exclusions are not inferred from what the mockup omits.

### Deferred

The customer deferred these gaps at DEC-006. They are not specified here.

- GAP-003 Date inputs do not visibly reflect the "only free dates" decision (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-004 When dates become unavailable and how clashes are prevented (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-010 Request form validation rules beyond overlap (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-011 Loans list empty, loading and error states not captured (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-012 Email notification content, recipients and delivery failure (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-013 Traceability of approvals and decisions (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-015 Repeated or duplicate request submissions (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-016 Accessibility of availability-limited date selection and status feedback (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-017 Date format inconsistency between list and form (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-018 Ordering and paging of the loans list (Deferred: DEC-006)

## 4. Users and Roles

- Staff member (requester): requests loans and sees their own requests (REQ-001, REQ-003, FEA-003). Whether anyone else can see a person's loans, or whether a request can be made for another person, is Unknown (FEA-004, Q-003).
- Line manager: approves or declines requests from their own direct reports only (DEC-003, FEA-001).
- Manager's own manager (stand-in): can act instead when the line manager is away (DEC-003). How "away" is determined, and whether both can act at once, is not decided (Q-001).
- Equipment administrator or owner: no document names such a role. Who maintains the item list and records returns is Unknown (Q-004, Q-006).
- Users are assumed to be individually identified (ASM-F-001, Assumption).

## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage

Capture status: complete, fixture mode, 2 pages captured, no failed requests and no recorded limitations.

- SCR-001 "My equipment loans": a table with columns Item, From, To, Status (SCR-003) and one row: Laptop L-221, 3 Mar, 7 Mar, Requested. It has a "Request equipment" link (SCR-004).
- SCR-002 "Request equipment": a form (SCR-005) with an Item selector (options Laptop and Projector, Laptop preselected), From and To date inputs with mm/dd/yyyy placeholders, and a "Submit request" button. No field shows a required marker.
- SCR-006: the "Request equipment" link leads from SCR-001 to SCR-002.
- SCR-007: the "Submit request" button has no target in the capture, so what happens after submission is not shown.
- SCR-008: the visible Equipment loan fields are Item, From, To and Status.

Not shown in the capture: any manager screen, any cancel, edit or return action, any decline reason, availability or blocked dates on the form, and any empty, loading or error state. The captured date inputs do not reflect the decided "only free dates" rule (DEC-001), which is why REQ-001 is Conflicting. The status "Requested" is not in the decided status list (DEC-005), which is why REQ-003 is Conflicting (Q-008).

## 8. Functional Requirements

### Requesting equipment

Staff choose an item and loan dates on the "Request equipment" form and submit a request.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-001** Staff can request an equipment loan by choosing an item and the loan dates. REQ-001 is in conflict and is not confirmed until the conflict is resolved: the captured form does not reflect the free-dates-only decision (GAP-003, deferred). Which items can be chosen, the date rules and whether one request can cover several items are not defined (Q-006). [Customer: REQ-001 · Conflicting] [Mockup: SCR-005]
- **FR-002** The request form offers only dates on which the chosen item is free. The captured form does not show this (see section 5). [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-003** Managers are notified by email when a request is submitted. Where addresses come from is not established (ASM-F-002). [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

- **FR-004** When a submission is rejected for a validation reason, the request form shows again with the user's Item, From and To values kept, and each message is shown next to the field it relates to. The source is a fixture page with low confidence and covers validation failure only. What staff see after a successful submission, and after other kinds of failure, is not decided (Q-009, Q-010). [Research: F-GAP-002-01 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-007] [Mockup: SCR-005]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-001** (draft) Given a signed-in staff member opens the "Request equipment" page, When the page loads, Then the form shows an Item selector, a From date input, a To date input and a Submit request button. - **AC-002** Given an existing loan holds Laptop L-221 for 3 Mar to 7 Mar (which request statuses hold an item's dates is not decided), When a staff member chooses that item on the request form, Then the form does not offer 3 Mar to 7 Mar as dates for it. - **AC-003** Given a staff member whose line manager is Alex submits a request, When the request is submitted, Then Alex receives an email. [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]

[Research: F-GAP-002-01 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-007]

### Approving and declining requests

Line managers decide requests from their own direct reports. The stand-in rule applies when the manager is away.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-005** Line managers can approve or decline loan requests from their own direct reports. The manager screen is not in the capture (Q-002). [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002] [Decision: DEC-003]
- **FR-006** When a line manager is away, the manager's own manager can approve or decline instead. How "away" is determined, and whether both can act at the same time, is not decided (Q-001). [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
- **FR-007** Staff are notified by email when their request is approved or declined. [Customer: FEA-006 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-004]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

- **FR-009** Once a request has been approved or declined, a second decision on it should not be applied, and the second person should be told it has already been decided. 13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	This feature lets staff request to borrow equipment, lets line managers approve or decline those requests, and lets staff see where their requests stand. The customer's three requirements are short, so most of the behaviour is not yet defined.
16	
17	What is decided: an item cannot be loaned to two people for overlapping dates and the form only offers free dates (DEC-001). Staff are emailed when a request is approved or declined, and managers are emailed when a request is submitted (DEC-004). Requests are pending, approved, declined, cancelled or returned, and staff see the status, the dates and any decline reason (DEC-005).

1	# Equipment Loan Requests: Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4

Research ran in fixture mode with recorded results only (robots.txt not checked). Research was limited to the first two research gaps by DEC-006. One finding was kept (F-GAP-002-01), with low confidence, and its source says it is a test fixture and not real documentation. The research for GAP-001 found no usable source.
10	- Open stale items: none
11	- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004, Q-005 and Q-006 are blocking and unanswered (see section 16). REQ-001 and REQ-003 carry the label Conflicting and GAP-006 is Conflicting (see sections 6 and 7).
12	
13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	This feature lets staff request to borrow equipment, lets line managers approve or decline those requests, and lets staff see where their requests stand. The customer's three requirements are short, so most of the behaviour is not yet defined.
16	
17	What is decided: an item cannot be loaned to two people for overlapping dates and the form only offers free dates (DEC-001). Only a requester's own line manager can decide a request, and that manager's own manager can step in when the manager is away (DEC-003). Staff are emailed when a request is approved or declined, and managers are emailed when a request is submitted (DEC-004). Requests are pending, approved, declined, cancelled or returned, and staff see the status, the dates and any decline reason (DEC-005).
18	
19	Key open decisions that block the specification: how a manager is known to be away, what the manager screen looks like, who can see a person's loans, who can cancel and who records a return, where reporting-line data comes from, and whether staff request specific assets or item types. The mockup also shows the status "Requested", which is not in the decided status list, and its date inputs do not show the free-dates-only rule. Ten gaps were deferred at checkpoint 2 and are listed under Deferred.
20	
21	## 3. Goals and Scope
22	
23	### Goals
24	
25	- Staff can request an equipment loan by choosing an item and loan dates (REQ-001).
26	- Line managers can approve or decline loan requests (REQ-002).
27	- Staff can see the status of their own loan requests (REQ-003).
28	- No item is ever loaned to two people for overlapping dates (DEC-001).
29	
30	### In Scope
31	
32	- The staff request form and the staff loans list, as captured in the mockup (SCR-001, SCR-002).
33	- Manager approval and decline of requests from direct reports, including the stand-in rule (DEC-003). No manager screen was captured, so its design is open (GAP-001, Q-002).
34	- Email notifications on submission and on approval or decline (DEC-004).
35	- The status set pending, approved, declined, cancelled and returned (DEC-005).
36	- Approved gaps awaiting customer decisions: GAP-001, GAP-002, GAP-005, GAP-006, GAP-007, GAP-008, GAP-009 and GAP-014.
37	
38	### Out of Scope / Rejected
39	
40	Nothing is recorded as rejected or excluded. The run's decisions contain no rejection, and no customer requirement excludes anything. Exclusions are not inferred from what the mockup omits.
41	
42	### Deferred
43	
44	The customer deferred these gaps at DEC-006. They are not specified here.
45	
46	- GAP-003 Date inputs do not visibly reflect the "only free dates" decision (Deferred: DEC-006)
47	- GAP-004 When dates become unavailable and how clashes are prevented (Deferred: DEC-006)
48	- GAP-010 Request form validation rules beyond overlap (Deferred: DEC-006)
49	- GAP-011 Loans list empty, loading and error states not captured (Deferred: DEC-006)
50	- GAP-012 Email notification content, recipients and delivery failure (Deferred: DEC-006)
51	- GAP-013 Traceability of approvals and decisions (Deferred: DEC-006)
52	- GAP-015 Repeated or duplicate request submissions (Deferred: DEC-006)
53	- GAP-016 Accessibility of availability-limited date selection and status feedback (Deferred: DEC-006)
54	- GAP-017 Date format inconsistency between list and form (Deferred: DEC-006)
55	- GAP-018 Ordering and paging of the loans list (Deferred: DEC-006)
56	
57	## 4. Users and Roles
58	
59	- Staff member (requester): requests loans and sees their own requests (REQ-001, REQ-003, FEA-003). Whether anyone else can see a person's loans, or whether a request can be made for another person, is Unknown (FEA-004, Q-003).
60	- Line manager: approves or declines requests from their own direct reports only (DEC-003, FEA-001).
61	- Manager's own manager (stand-in): can act instead when the line manager is away (DEC-003). How "away" is determined, and whether both can act at once, is not decided (Q-001).
62	- Equipment administrator or owner: no document names such a role. Who maintains the item list and records returns is Unknown (Q-004, Q-006).
63	- Users are assumed to be individually identified (ASM-F-001, Assumption).
64	
65	## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage
66	
67	Capture status: complete, fixture mode, 2 pages captured, no failed requests and no recorded limitations.
68	
69	- SCR-001 "My equipment loans": a table with columns Item, From, To, Status (SCR-003) and one row: Laptop L-221, 3 Mar, 7 Mar, Requested. It has a "Request equipment" link (SCR-004).
70	- SCR-002 "Request equipment": a form (SCR-005) with an Item selector (options Laptop and Projector, Laptop preselected), From and To date inputs with mm/dd/yyyy placeholders, and a "Submit request" button. No field shows a required marker.
71	- SCR-006: the "Request equipment" link leads from SCR-001 to SCR-002.
72	- SCR-007: the "Submit request" button has no target in the capture, so what happens after submission is not shown.
73	- SCR-008: the visible Equipment loan fields are Item, From, To and Status.
74	
75	Not shown in the capture: any manager screen, any cancel, edit or return action, any decline reason, availability or blocked dates on the form, and any empty, loading or error state. The captured date inputs do not reflect the decided "only free dates" rule (DEC-001), which is why REQ-001 is Conflicting. The status "Requested" is not in the decided status list (DEC-005), which is why REQ-003 is Conflicting (Q-008).

# Equipment Loan Requests: Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261012-154937-f3f269
- Date: 2026-10-12
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: eval_only
- Known limitations: Capture status is complete (2 pages, no capture limitations recorded), but it was taken from a fixture, so only two screens exist and no manager screen, empty, loading or error state was captured. Research ran in fixture mode with recorded results only (robots.txt not checked). Research was limited to the first two research gaps by DEC-006. One finding was kept (F-GAP-002-01), with low confidence, and its source says it is a test fixture and not real documentation. The research for GAP-001 found no usable source.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-004, Q-005 and Q-006 are blocking and unanswered (see section 16). REQ-001 and REQ-003 carry the label Conflicting and GAP-006 is Conflicting (see sections 6 and 7). The review passed in round 3 with no unresolved review issues.

## 2. Executive Summary

This feature lets staff request to borrow equipment, lets line managers approve or decline those requests, and lets staff see where their requests stand. The customer's three requirements are short, so most of the behaviour is not yet defined.

What is decided: an item cannot be loaned to two people for overlapping dates and the form only offers free dates (DEC-001). Only a requester's own line manager can decide a request, and that manager's own manager can step in when the manager is away (DEC-003). Staff are emailed when a request is approved or declined, and managers are emailed when a request is submitted (DEC-004). Requests are pending, approved, declined, cancelled or returned, and staff see the status, the dates and any decline reason (DEC-005).

Key open decisions that block the specification: how a manager is known to be away, what the manager screen looks like, who can see a person's loans, who can cancel and who records a return, where reporting-line data comes from, and whether staff request specific assets or item types. The mockup also shows the status "Requested", which is not in the decided status list, and its date inputs do not show the free-dates-only rule. Ten gaps were deferred at checkpoint 2 and are listed under Deferred.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Staff can request an equipment loan by choosing an item and loan dates (REQ-001).
- Line managers can approve or decline loan requests (REQ-002).
- Staff can see the status of their own loan requests (REQ-003).
- No item is ever loaned to two people for overlapping dates (DEC-001).

### In Scope

- The staff request form and the staff loans list, as captured in the mockup (SCR-001, SCR-002).
- Manager approval and decline of requests from direct reports, including the stand-in rule (DEC-003). No manager screen was captured, so its design is open (GAP-001, Q-002).
- Email notifications on submission and on approval or decline (DEC-004).
- The status set pending, approved, declined, cancelled and returned (DEC-005).
- Approved gaps awaiting customer decisions: GAP-001, GAP-002, GAP-005, GAP-006, GAP-007, GAP-008, GAP-009 and GAP-014.

### Out of Scope / Rejected

Nothing is recorded as rejected or excluded. The run's decisions contain no rejection, and no customer requirement excludes anything. Exclusions are not inferred from what the mockup omits.

### Deferred

The customer deferred these gaps at DEC-006. They are not specified here.

- GAP-003 Date inputs do not visibly reflect the "only free dates" decision (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-004 When dates become unavailable and how clashes are prevented (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-010 Request form validation rules beyond overlap (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-011 Loans list empty, loading and error states not captured (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-012 Email notification content, recipients and delivery failure (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-013 Traceability of approvals and decisions (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-015 Repeated or duplicate request submissions (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-016 Accessibility of availability-limited date selection and status feedback (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-017 Date format inconsistency between list and form (Deferred: DEC-006)
- GAP-018 Ordering and paging of the loans list (Deferred: DEC-006)

## 4. Users and Roles

- Staff member (requester): requests loans and sees their own requests (REQ-001, REQ-003, FEA-003). Whether anyone else can see a person's loans, or whether a request can be made for another person, is Unknown (FEA-004, Q-003).
- Line manager: approves or declines requests from their own direct reports only (DEC-003, FEA-001).
- Manager's own manager (stand-in): can act instead when the line manager is away (DEC-003). How "away" is determined, and whether both can act at once, is not decided (Q-001).
- Equipment administrator or owner: no document names such a role. Who maintains the item list and records returns is Unknown (Q-004, Q-006).
- Users are assumed to be individually identified (ASM-F-001, Assumption).
